blurb: Guests ride snowmobiles on over 150 miles of groomed trails and single tracks in the White River National Forest. Tours include stops at a private yurt for hot beverages and snacks. Complimentary hotel pickups are provided in Vail and Beaver Creek.
extraNote: 48-hour cancellation policy for regular, group and private tours · Customary guide gratuity of 20% not included · Complimentary pickups from all major hotels in Vail and Beaver Creek

quotes.text: Absolutely sensational, Nathan is incredible Our tour guide, Nathan, is absolutely phenomenal. We have used him for two years and the tours are absolutely incredible. He is so professional, friendly and does everything to make your tour absolutely breathtaking. Everybody on staff is phenomenal. We did a tour yesterday And it was absolutely amazing. Nathan is absolutely sensational, we were talking about how he is absolutely so professional, friendly, and he even remembered our name from last year! Rafe, Julia, Oliviaread moreread less

Great views We had an amazing day snowmobiling just 5 minutes away from our accommodation in Vail Village, unlike other companies we tried before where you need to drive for about an hour each way. The trails were fantastic, small group, snowmobiles in excellent condition with a couple stops for pictures. We even had a change to drive fast in a special oval track near a hut where the provide hot chocolate and cookies, they are have a portable toilet if you need to use. Our guide was very attentiveread moreread less

Once in a lifetime experience! Spectacular first time snowmobiling experience! Gregg was a fantastic guide. The company has excellent equipment and takes the time to explain everything. We felt very comfortable and confident. The Yurt is an awesome stop for hot drinks and warm cookies and brownies. Can’t say enough positive about this company. Once in a lifetime experience with gorgeous views. Not a sissy ride either! At times we went 35+ mph. Do this!! Worth every penny!read moreread less

Great Family Adventure This is the second time that we have used Vail Backcountry Tours for snowmobiling. It was even better this second time (and I wouldn’t have thought that was possible). Our guide (Greg) was phenomenal. You can tell they are very focused on a great balance of an exhilarating adventure, beautiful scenery and safety. These memories with my family will last a lifetime and will always be treasured by us.read moreread less

Don’t hesitate to book this tour! This was such a great experience — just the right balance of thrills and scenery. Greg was our guide, and he was friendly, knowledgeable, and patient with the varied experience levels in our group. The trail was well maintained (but not so well that it wasn’t fun), and it as clear the equipment was as well. Two thumbs up — HIGHLY recommend!read moreread less

Back Country Snowmobiling in the Gore Range We went on the 3 hour snowmobile VBT yesterday with friends and it was outstanding! Greg, our guide, did a great job and kept us all organized. I really enjoyed that the tour start was only 5 minutes from Vail/Lionshead with easy access, parking and shuttle. The machines were top, new equipment. Couldn’t recommend more highly!read moreread less
